SELECT
  home_stores_src_10000.region AS home_store__region
  , selling_stores_src_10000.region AS store__region
  , SUM(subq_5.__order_count) AS order_count
  , SUM(subq_5.__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(subq_5.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_id AS store
    , home_store_id AS home_store
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_semantic_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_5
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  "data"."main"."stores" home_stores_src_10000
ON
  subq_5.home_store = home_stores_src_10000.store_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  "data"."main"."stores" selling_stores_src_10000
ON
  subq_5.store = selling_stores_src_10000.store_id
GROUP BY
  home_stores_src_10000.region
  , selling_stores_src_10000.region
